title: Penguin holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='24' ry='28' fill='#3b4a8c'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='16' ry='21' fill='#e8eef7'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='17' fill='#3b4a8c'/>

  <polygon points='50,36 45,41 55,41' fill='#ffb93c'/>

</svg>
